parameters.name: JobId
parameters.description: The ID of the migration job.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The name of the migration source. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter but cannot start with http:// or https://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

This parameter is empty by default.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RelatedJobType
parameters.description: The type of migration job that is associated with the migration source.

parameters.name: SourceId
parameters.description: The migration source ID. You can specify multiple IDs.

parameters.name: State
parameters.description:
The state of the migration source. Valid values:

*   Unavailable: The migration source is inactive, or an error occurs in the migration source.
*   Available: The migration source is active.
*   InUse: The migration source is being migrated.
*   Deleting: The migration source is being deleted from Server Migration Center (SMC).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun smc describe-source-servers --job-id j-bp19vlwm0tyigbmj0000 --state Available --name testSourceServerName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --source-id s-bp1e2fsl57knvuug0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmw3ty5y70000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --related-job-type Server --workgroup-id w-bp1ja22kdqphehlj0000 --region cn-hangzhou
